counterfactual_fixtures.purpose: Adds a vehicle with no maintenance in the window.
Adds boundary maintenance rows at the lower and upper bounds.

reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT v.vehicle_id, COUNT(m.maintenance_id) AS maintenance_count FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN maintenance_events m ON m.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id AND m.performed_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-05-31 12:00:00+00' AND m.performed_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-30 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY v.vehicle_id ORDER BY v.vehicle_id

reference_implementation_b.sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT vehicle_id, COUNT(*) AS maintenance_count FROM maintenance_events WHERE performed_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-05-31 12:00:00+00' AND performed_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-30 12:00:00+00' GROUP BY vehicle_id) SELECT v.vehicle_id, COALESCE(recent.maintenance_count, 0)::BIGINT FROM vehicles v LEFT JOIN recent ON recent.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id ORDER BY v.vehicle_id

semantic_mutants.description: Drops vehicles with no recent maintenance.
